research_rationale: ORIGINAL:EO:12521 adds two independently operative subparagraphs. The first delegates offsets reporting to OMB with further delegation and information duties; the second authorizes collection for the first report. Exact spans separate those effects. ACTOR_TEXT:EO:12649 replaces the second subparagraph with BEA collection authority; therefore a blanket 1994 first-end assignment would ignore a held earlier partial replacement and possible still-earlier first-report completion. ACTOR_TEXT:EO:12148 predates this order and cannot itself terminate a later command. ACTOR_TEXT:EO:12919 contains successor offsets responsibilities and savings as well as formal revocation. Underlying statutory changes and effective dates remain unproved.
